case: PostgreSQL timestamptz[] XLSX re-import through LibreOffice Calc
contract: PostgreSQL native pg_typeof, array_to_json and array_send checks verify a timestamptz[] with two distinct instants during the New York fall-back hour, a BC instant, both infinities and SQL NULL.
BookieE exports the array's exact canonical text in an XLSX shared-string cell without a formula.
LibreOffice Calc opens the workbook, saves ODS, reopens it and saves XLSX; the shared-string cell text is unchanged across all three files and no formula is created.

bookiee_export.command: rtk proxy env BOOKIEE_XLSX_REIMPORT_ARTIFACT=<evidence-dir>/source.xlsx cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration array_contract::value_contract_timestamptz_array_file_exports_preserve_instants -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

steps: In the pinned Debian image, install libreoffice-calc; Calc opens source.xlsx and saves recheck/source.ods.
Calc reopens recheck/source.ods and saves resave/source.xlsx, retained as calc-roundtrip.xlsx.

consumer_assertions.result: The exact shared-string text matches across XLSX, ODS and re-saved XLSX; all cells are text and contain no formulas.

clippy.command: rtk cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings
